core_obligations: Show that base change by g determines a bijection z(X/S, r) -> z(X'/S', r) (proof lines 1507-1524). By lemma-pullback-universally-bijective (tag 0H4Y) there is a bijection between the families of r-cycles on the fibres of X/S and of X'/S', so it suffices to check compatibility with specializations (proof lines 1508-1512). For a family alpha with pullback alpha' = g^*alpha: any morphism h : Spec(R) -> S from a discrete valuation ring factors uniquely as g composed with some h' : Spec(R) -> S', because S' x_S Spec(R) -> Spec(R) is a universal homeomorphism inducing bijections on residue fields and hence has a section, since R is a seminormal ring by the seminormalization section of the Morphisms chapter (tag 0EUK) (proof lines 1513-1519). Hence the condition that alpha is compatible with specializations is equivalent to the condition that alpha' is compatible with specializations, i.e., alpha is a relative r-cycle exactly when alpha' is (proof lines 1520-1523).
proof_roadmap: Bijection on families of r-cycles on fibres from the universally bijective pullback lemma (proof lines 1508-1512).
Unique factorization of DVR-valued points through g via the section supplied by seminormality of R (proof lines 1513-1519).
Equivalence of the specialization compatibility conditions closes the bijection onto relative cycles (proof lines 1520-1523).
